question: How many unique sessions visited the /regist/input page and then the /regist/confirm page, in that order?
sql:
WITH input_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
),
confirm_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session
    FROM form_log
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
),
both_sessions AS (
    SELECT i.session
    FROM input_sessions i
    JOIN confirm_sessions c ON i.session = c.session
),
order_check AS (
    SELECT bs.session
    FROM both_sessions bs
    WHERE (SELECT MIN(f1.stamp) FROM form_log f1 WHERE f1.session = bs.session AND f1.path = '/regist/input')
          < 
          (SELECT MIN(f2.stamp) FROM form_log f2 WHERE f2.session = bs.session AND f2.path = '/regist/confirm')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) FROM order_check;
